name: tia_find_module_types
description: Search the TIA hardware catalog for complete type identifiers by a partial one (Openness ModuleInformationProvider.FindModuleTypes), with their container types. OrderNumber needs one complete part ('OrderNumber:6ES7 214-1AG40-0XB0'), GSD at least two ('GSD:GSDML-V2.4-ABB-FPNO-20220101.XML/D'), System one ('System:Rack.ET200SP'). No wildcards. GSD/GSDML files must be installed in TIA Portal first (Options > Manage general station description files); Openness cannot install them.

partial_type_identifier.description: Partial type identifier made of complete '/'-separated parts.
